_meta.description: Financial transaction records with three distinct quality issues: user_id nulls (8.4%), mixed-case country values ('US', 'us', 'United States', 'UK', 'uk', 'CA', 'ca'), and extreme amount outliers (39 values beyond 3×IQR — injected fraud transaction amounts of 8500, 12000, 25000, 47500 against a normal range of 1-2000). The is_fraud column has a 32.33:1 class imbalance which may be noted as context.
